5269578.baseName: Habitat 200 Bright White LED Christmas Tree Lights
5269578.variantName: Habitat 200 Bright White LED Christmas Tree Lights
5269578.sourceDescription: Light up your Christmas or Diwali celebrations with these 200 LED string lights in bright white. They're battery operated so you can hang them wherever you fancy, inside or out, without hunting for a plug socket. You're getting 8 different light functions to play with, from flashes and fades to twinkles, or you can keep things classic with a steady shine. The cable stretches nearly 12m when fully extended, giving you plenty of length to work with. The built-in timer is a lifesaver when you've strung them up outdoors. Set it once and they'll come on for 8 hours, then switch off for 16 hours, cycling through on their own without you needing to step outside every evening. Just make sure the battery pack stays somewhere dry and sheltered. It runs on 3xAA batteries so you can place them exactly where you want that warm glow, no mains power needed. . y7483t3e.variantName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Frosted Ultra Mountain Pine Christmas Tree
y7483t3e.sourceDescription: Brr! The Frosted Ultra Mountain Pine's cool flocking effortlessly combines the Ultra Mountain Pine's realism and the wintery colour scheme of our snowy Christmas trees. nw010vvq.baseName: Christmas Tree World 40cm Green Metallic Inflatable Mirror Ball
nw010vvq.variantName: Christmas Tree World 40cm Green Metallic Inflatable Mirror Ball
nw010vvq.sourceDescription: Introducing the 40cm Inflatable Mirror Display Ball in Green, a striking and versatile decorative solution designed to create instant impact in retail environments, commercial venues, events, exhibitions, and the home. Featuring a sleek mirror finish, this inflatable display ball reflects light and surroundings beautifully, making it ideal for eye-catching shop windows, visual merchandising, brand activations, and large-scale installations. A key advantage for commercial users is ease of storage. Once deflated or with the air removed using a compatible electric pump the display ball folds down to a fraction of its inflated size, making off-season storage simple and space-efficient. Manufactured from fire-retardant materials, the Inflatable Mirror Display Ball is suitable for use in commercial and public spaces. It is inflated once, sealed securely, and displayed without the need for a continuous power supply. xy0x7zfj.variantName: Vivo Technologies Christmas Tree Stand with Reservoir
xy0x7zfj.sourceDescription: This sturdy Christmas tree stand is made from heavy-duty plastic and features a wide 56 cm base for reliable stability and a low centre of gravity. Designed specifically for real Christmas trees, it supports trees up to 7 ft tall with a maximum trunk diameter of 11 cm. The base includes a 1.5 L water reservoir to help keep the tree fresh throughout the festive season, while four heavy duty eye bolts securely hold the trunk in place. The four removable legs allow for easy assembly and compact storage, and the stand is suitable for indoor and outdoor use. Specifications: Heavy duty plastic construction, suitable for real Christmas trees up to 7 ft tall, maximum trunk diameter of 11 cm, 1.5 L water reservoir, four heavy-duty eye bolts, four removable legs, low profile design for stability, suitable for indoor and outdoor use, and item weight of 1.36 kg. Dimensions: Length: 56 cm, width: 56 cm, height: 15 cm. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG
